title: Elu's Trees
description:
Elu's Trees

A mod that adds 5 trees
body:
Elu's Trees
A Minecraft mod that adds 5 different trees to minecraft with special wood too

Currently these trees do not generate and can be only obtained through wondering Villigers

===================

The tree's that have been added are
Blank Tree
A white tree with white planks and logs

Diamond Tree
A light blue tree with light blue planks and logs

Gold Tree
A gold tree with gold planks and logs

Magma Tree
A magma tree with magma planks and logs

Water Tree
A tree with water planks and logs

===================

This mod was mostly made for building with more colored wood and it was made for fun. nothing serious haha
